tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec122/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && PLUGIN_ROOT="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/plugins/system-spec-harness" && python3 -I -c '
import json,collections
s=json.load(open("system-spec/spec-state.json"))
print("schema",s.get("schema_version"),"keys",sorted(s.keys()))
print("hearing_progress",s.get("hearing_progress"))
f=s.get("requirements_foundation",{}); print("foundation confirmed",f.get("confirmed"),f.get("approval_ref"))
c=collections.Counter(v.get("state") for cat in s["matrix"].values() for v in (cat.get("cells",cat) if isinstance(cat,dict) else {}).values() if isinstance(v,dict))
print(c); print("targets",[t.get("target_id") for t in s.get("targets",[])]); print("decisions",[d.get("id") or d.get("decision_id") for d in s.get("decisions",[])])
print("qa",len(s.get("qa_log",[])),"approvals",len(s.get("approval_log",[])))
'; for a in "" "--require-foundation" "--require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation"; do python3 -B "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py" --matrix system-spec/spec-state.json $a >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "coverage[$a]=$?"; done; python3 -B "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/validate-design-knowledge-refs.py" --matrix "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec/spec-state.json" --repo-root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo dkr=$?; python3 -B "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/validate-knowledge-graph.py" --profile required-info --input "$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/run-system-spec-elicit/references/required-info-catalog.json" --state "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec/spec-state.json" > $TMPDIR/ri.json; echo ri=$?; python3 -I -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));print("ungrounded",d["coverage_certificate"]["ungrounded_blocking_items"])' $TMPDIR/ri.json; wc -l plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/run-system-spec-elicit/prompts/*.md plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/run-system-spec-elicit/references/*
